title: Regression runs
note: Door A of chain-qa (card CQ-1): one record per regression run of a registered chain — the chain executed at its PINNED ref, on GOLDEN fixtures, diffed against BLESSED. A record carries METADATA AND POINTERS ONLY: chain, pin (the sha actually checked out), run-id, fixture ids, per-stage status, and per-output diff verdicts with the layer that produced each. Never media, never an output's text (workspace rule 3, the durable_url pattern) — media bytes live under the regression Drive root at 'Shared Assets/regression/<chain>/<run-id>/', which is resolved at run time through storage.py: drive_root() and never carries an account name. The RUN itself lives in the regression clone (~/.chain-qa/clones/<chain>/<ref>/.chain-qa-runs/<run-id>/), outside every work checkout: a chain author's board, worktree and Drive paths are never touched, which is the isolation this kind exists to make visible. Item id = the run-id, so re-filing is idempotent and the latest record by `created` wins — fold, never edit. EMPTY IS NOT A PASS, carried through into the record: an UNBLESSED fixture never passes, and an unrunnable stage is a FAIL carrying its reason, never a skip and never a silent zero.

_reserved_ids.runs-index: cumulative run-id -> {chain, pin, opened, verdict}; the platform lists records only per KNOWN item id, so this is how a browser discovers record-borne runs. Same mechanism as teardown-runs' runs-index and the inbox's filed-index.
_reserved_ids.wall-status: the isolation ledger of the last dry structural run, filed only when the answer changes. `clean`, `unresolved` and `breached` are different statuses on purpose: a zone that could not be resolved must never read as a proven wall, and a breach STOPS ALL RUNS.

verdict_fields.note: exactly one per record. `index` appears only on the reserved id `runs-index`, `wall` only on `wall-status`.
the registered chain name from platform/data/chains.json
{ref, sha} — the declared ref AND the sha actually checked out. A run that cannot state its pin is not a regression result.
the run-id; equals the record's item id
`unrunnable` is a FAIL with its reason, never a skip — a stage that could not run is exactly the case a silent zero would hide.
[{id, blessed}] — an UNBLESSED fixture never passes; the flag is on the record so nobody has to go and check.
array of {key, class, status, seconds, reason}. `reason` is required whenever status is not `done`.

array of {stage, output, diff (exact|judged|perceptual), verdict (same|changed|fail|unrunnable), layer, detail, blessed_ref}. The diff policy is DECLARED PER OUTPUT in chains.json; this field records which one actually ran and what it said.
{modality, vendor, model, score, threshold} on judged/perceptual verdicts. Routing is measurement-backed: Claude for stills, Gemini for video.
{usd, basis} — priced from platform/workers/mini-worker/prices.json where the vendor is priced there; a lower bound with its coverage, never an authoritative total.
[{stage, output, drive_path, bytes}] — drive_path is RELATIVE to the shared drive so it resolves on any teammate's own mount. Pointers only.
{clone, drive, records} — the three permitted zones this run resolved, so the wall is on the record and not only in a log.
run-id -> {chain, pin, opened, verdict}; cumulative, latest record wins
`empty` = a plan that would write nowhere, which is a FAIL and not a clean sheet. `unresolved` = a zone that could not be resolved (Drive unmounted, or a refused read) — never collapsed into `clean`.
true for `breached` and `unresolved`. A breach stops ALL runs (kill-condition, card CQ-1).
every path the dry structural run planned, with its zone and verdict. The wall is PROVEN by this list, never asserted.
